name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
title: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd - 543387 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR2,601.2m (+29.7% Y-o-Y) with EBITDA margin 30.3%; capacity additions are in commissioning and the company guides 1.5x–2x industry growth for FY27, with capex of about INR260–270 crore over three years.

utilisation.quote: SJS Bangalore facility with the improved revenue what we have in FY26, we have now reached around 75% of our capacity.

capex.quote: Apart from that, we have the normal capex, which is around INR15 - 20 crores per annum.

triggers.label: SDPL utilisation 95%+
triggers.quote: they are operating 95%+ kind of a capacity utilization

triggers.label: Capex spend INR80 crore of ~INR260-270 crore
triggers.quote: out of which, INR80 crores happened in the last year

triggers.label: FY27 outperformance 1.5x–2x (was 2.5x)
triggers.quote: we expect to outperform underlying industry growth by 1.5x to 2x in FY27

triggers.label: Order book over 85% of FY27 forecast
triggers.quote: the current order book being over 85% of the FY27 forecasted revenue

guidance.quote: we expect to outperform underlying industry growth by 1.5x to 2x in FY27
working towards increasing share of exports in our consolidated revenue to 14% to 15% by FY 28
in the long term, I think that 27% - 28% sort of margins with a high growth trajectory is what you should expect from SJS

guidance.value: INR220 crore; total INR260-270 crore over 3 years
guidance.quote: So on a 3-year basis, we could say INR260 crores, INR270 crores.
we expect supplies to start by early FY 27 and -- could be earlier, but this early FY 28

prior_guidance_check.metric: Capex spend FY26 (INR45 cr Bangalore + INR100 cr chrome plant)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have spent only INR80 crores, if I'm not wrong, the CFO sir just said
I said that we will outgrow the market or outperform the market by 2.5x last year
By the end of this quarter, we will have this plant fully ready.

red_flags.quote: Our performance has been not the best.
